criteria.title: Service mutation REST routes are removed
criteria.assertion: POST /api/v1/services, PUT /api/v1/services/{id}, and DELETE /api/v1/services/{id} are not registered and return 405 against the retained read-route paths.

criteria.title: Environment mutation REST routes are removed
criteria.assertion: POST /api/v1/environments, PUT /api/v1/environments/{id}, and DELETE /api/v1/environments/{id} are not registered and return 405 against the retained read-route paths.

criteria.title: Deprecated REST handlers are deleted without removing read handlers or shared types
criteria.assertion: ServiceHandler.Create/Update/Delete, EnvironmentHandler.Create/Update/Delete, and REST-only mutation helper functions are absent while ServiceHandler.Get/List, EnvironmentHandler.Get/List, DTO types, and registry domain services remain available.

criteria.title: Tests and client helpers do not call removed REST mutation endpoints
criteria.assertion: Affected router tests seed service/environment prerequisites directly, client mutation helpers return explicit Nostr migration errors instead of POSTing removed endpoints, and tests assert no removed REST call is made.

criteria.title: Documentation points service/environment mutations at signer-first Nostr commands
criteria.assertion: User-facing docs and the REST deprecation plan no longer present service/environment REST mutations as available behavior and identify the relevant Nostr command path.
